claims.text: MusicBrainz lists “Amen, Brother” by The Winstons as first released in 1969.
The six-second drum solo in “Amen, Brother” became known as the Amen Break.
The BBC describes the Amen Break as a six-second drum solo from this 1969 recording, later sampled by artists including The Prodigy, Oasis and N.W.A.
